steps.label: docker
steps.cmd: apt-get update && apt-get install -y docker.io docker-compose-v2

steps.label: up
steps.cmd: docker rm -f spawnables-code-server >/dev/null 2>&1; docker run -d --restart unless-stopped --name spawnables-code-server -p 8080:8080 -v /opt/spawnables-services/code-server:/home/coder/.local codercom/code-server:latest

notes: vs code in the guest's browser at localhost:8080, which is what we actually ship when someone says 'vscode': microsoft's own build is mit-licensed but its marketplace terms are not, so the oss editor (openvscode-server or code-server) is the honest default and the card says which one it is.
